Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the source and adopted a malformed, non-existent title (“Louis de Bourbon-Toulouse, Duke of Penthièvre”) as the father-in-law of the Princesse de Lamballe, replacing the correct father-in-law (Louis Jean Marie de Bourbon, Duke of Penthièvre). This error led to repeated instructions to verify a non-existent page and failed to resolve the initial disambiguation (for Maria Luisa Gabriella of Savoy, whose father-in-law is Louis, Grand Dauphin), thereby driving the process toward an incorrect solution.
